correct.description: Hip crease at or below knee level, knees tracking over toes, chest up, weight through heels

common_errors.description: Left knee collapses inward during descent or ascent
Right knee collapses inward during descent or ascent
Hip crease does not reach knee level at bottom position

keypoint_signature.rule: left_hip.y < left_knee.y AND right_hip.y < right_knee.y at bottom

coaching_cues.setup: Stand hip-width apart, toes slightly turned out
coaching_cues.execution: Drive your knees out, chest up, weight through your heels
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Solid work. Next set, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.shallow_depth: Sit a little deeper — hip crease to knee level

knee_injury.modification: Reduce depth. Stop at the point where you feel knee discomfort. Consider a box squat.

back_injury.modification: Keep your torso more upright and avoid forward lean. Stop if you feel lumbar pressure.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding (Valsalva). Breathe out on the way up, in on the way down.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only (ADR-100/102). May refine form score and detect rule-less errors (e.g. butt wink, asymmetric loading). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until expert-agreement eval passes.
